# Feature: AppFlow local test-session authentication

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-04 — issue 385 / PR-11 -->

## Intent

Let users manually log in once in a local Preview browser, persist an opaque Playwright storageState bound to project+origin, reuse it for crawls, and clear it — without leaking cookie/token values into analysis artifacts or logs.

## Preconditions

- Local Preview Runner ready with previewUrl
- Project id available

## Happy Path

- [ ] User can open login browser, persist session, see opaque ready status
- [ ] Crawl reuses storageState for matching project+origin
- [ ] User can clear session (status missing)
- [ ] UI/API responses expose only opaque sessionId/status/origin/savedAt

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Wrong origin → session not applied; auth-barrier when login wall detected
- [ ] Corrupt storageState → invalid status; crawl auth-barrier
- [ ] Expired/missing session → crawl without storage or auth-barrier on login wall
- [ ] Logs/redaction never print cookie/token values

## Regression

- [ ] Frontier crawl still works without session
- [ ] SafeActionPolicy unchanged

## Assumptions

- Sessions stored under `~/.visudev/test-sessions/` locally only
- No cloud sync / credential vault

## Implementation Notes

- Files: test-session-store, runtime-crawl session wiring, runner /session APIs, AppFlowTestSessionPanel
- Tests: preview-runner/lib/test-session-store.test.mjs

## Composition Gate

### Event

User persists test session → crawl loads storageState by project+origin → pages authenticated.

### Hops

1. test-session-store save/load/clear (opaque meta)
2. runner session endpoints
3. runRuntimeCrawl({ storageState })
4. AppFlow UI shows status only

### Simulations

| Case                  | Expected    | Observed |
| --------------------- | ----------- | -------- |
| save+load same origin | ready       |          |
| wrong origin          | not applied |          |
| corrupt file          | invalid     |          |

## Security Coverage

- Cookie/token never in ScanSnapshot/logs/UI (B-01 / P-04 style)
- Session bound to project+origin

## Typed-strict

- Touched files: zero type escape hatches
